guard: Existing manager issuance refuses environment-family gates and its plain preparation claims a native create-only gate before releasing direct-store credentials
why: The suite drives the actual hosted auth service and a JWT-auth private NATS broker. It checks terminal family refusals, unchanged gates, ordinary preparation and competing native family reservations. Its finally block closes the service and fixture before a named assertion failure exits.

mutations.name: existing manager authority ignores the environment family
mutations.expectRed: human-family prepare refuses an environment gate in open before releasing direct-store credentials
mutations.cell: human-family prepare refuses an environment gate in open before releasing direct-store credentials

mutations.name: plain preparation releases before its native family reservation
mutations.expectRed: plain preparation reserves its native family before credential release
mutations.cell: plain preparation reserves its native family before credential release
